test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The First Commonwealth Games were organised in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1930**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **First Commonwealth Games:-**

 
 
• **These were held in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada from August 16 to 23, 1930.**
 
• The event was opened by Lord Willingdon, the Governor General of Canada
 
• 11 countries participated: Australia, Canada, England, Ireland, New Zealand, Newfoundland, Scotland, South Africa, Wales, India and Bermuda
 
• 400 athletes competed in 10 sports: athletics, aquatics, boxing, cycling, lawn bowls, rowing, shooting, weightlifting, wrestling, and cricket
 
• England won the most medals with 38 gold, 31 silver, and 33 bronze
 
• Canada won the second most medals with 18 gold, 18 silver, and 21 bronze
 
• The Games were a success and helped to promote friendship and understanding among the nations of the British Empire
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Upcoming Commonwealth Games are:-
 
 
• **2026 Commonwealth Games**: The 2026 Commonwealth Games, officially known as the XXIII Commonwealth Games, is a proposed multi-sport event for members of the Commonwealth. The games are currently without a host, after Victoria, Australia withdrew its bid in July 2023.
 
• **2030 Commonwealth Games:** The 2030 Commonwealth Games, officially known as the XXIV Commonwealth Games, is a proposed multi-sport event for members of the Commonwealth. The games are scheduled to be held in Canada, with Edmonton, Alberta and Hamilton, Ontario being the two candidate cities.
